notes: Phase 1 knowledge-base evaluation: UK VAT questions whose answers are stated in the GOV.UK/HMRC guidance ingested by scripts/ingest_govuk.py. Run before and after ingestion (run_baseline_eval.py --only uk_vat) to measure the knowledge base. Facts as published on GOV.UK on 2026-10-01.

cases.question: What is the UK VAT registration threshold?
Below what turnover can a business deregister from VAT in the UK?
If my UK turnover goes over the VAT threshold, how long do I have to register?
Can I register for VAT in the UK if my turnover is below the threshold?
What are the UK VAT rates?
What VAT rate applies to domestic fuel and power in the UK?
cases.note: GOV.UK VAT Notice 701/19 (updated 8 Sep 2026): reduced rate 5%, plus a temporary zero rate on domestic electricity in Great Britain from 1 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027.

cases.question: What is the VAT rate on children's car seats in the UK?
Do children's clothes have VAT in the UK?
Is hot takeaway food zero-rated for VAT in the UK?
What is the deadline for submitting a UK VAT return and paying the VAT?
How often do UK businesses usually submit VAT returns?
Who can submit a VAT return for my business in the UK?
Do I need special software to file VAT returns in the UK?
What records must I keep digitally under Making Tax Digital for VAT?
How long must I keep VAT records in the UK?
cases.note: gov.uk/vat-record-keeping now 301-redirects to /charge-reclaim-record-vat; the retention rule is on its 'Keeping VAT records' page.

cases.question: What must a valid UK VAT invoice include?
Can a VAT-registered business reclaim VAT on business purchases in the UK?
What is the turnover limit to join the VAT Flat Rate Scheme?
When must a business leave the VAT Flat Rate Scheme?
What flat rate percentage does a limited cost trader use?
What is the turnover limit for the VAT Cash Accounting Scheme?
How many VAT returns do I submit under the Annual Accounting Scheme?
How do penalty points work for late VAT returns if I file quarterly?
What penalty applies if I pay my VAT 20 days late?
cases.note: GOV.UK (2026-10-01): first late payment penalty 3% of the VAT owed at day 15. Was 2% before April 2025; the first version of this case wrongly expected 2%.

cases.question: Under the VAT domestic reverse charge for construction, who accounts for the VAT?

cases.note: From the held-out set. Known failure: answers merge HMRC's '£1.35m in the last 3 months → pay straight away' rule into the exit rule and omit the £1.6m exit threshold; claim verification judges each sentence defensible.

cases.question: What VAT rate applies to women's sanitary products in the UK?
cases.note: From the held-out set. VAT Notice 700 §29.3.14 still describes these as reduced-rated; Notice 701/18 (ingested) gives the zero rate from 1 January 2021.
